title.target: La mise en relief : c'est ... qui / que, ce qui ... c'est

ex.t: Cette phrase met en relief le sujet.
Il a insisté sur la qualité du service.
ex.en: He stressed the importance of honesty.
The incident gave rise to controversy.

ex.t: C'est précisément ce que je voulais dire.
ex.en: The crux of the matter is trust.
That amounts to nothing more than an excuse.

ex.t: Le véritable problème, c'est le manque de temps.
Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.
ex.en: I never intended to hurt anyone.

ex.t: Il est compétent et, de surcroît, aimable.
Ce n'est pas lui qui a tort, au contraire.

ex.en: It was the very person who helped me.

title.ko: mise en relief : c'est ... qui/que · ce qui ... c'est · ce dont ... c'est · voilà ce que
title.en: Focus structures: c'est ... qui/que, ce qui/que/dont ... c'est, voilà ce que

explain.ko: 초점을 두는 구문은 정보를 강조합니다. c'est + 강조할 요소 + qui(주어)/que(목적어·부사어): C'est Marie qui a téléphoné. / C'est demain que nous partons. ce qui(주어), ce que(목적어), ce dont(de 보어) + 절 + c'est + 강조 요소: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le retard. Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de repos. 비교적 구어와 문어 모두에서 자주 쓰입니다.
explain.en: Focus structures emphasise information. C'est + focused element + qui (subject) / que (object, adverbial): C'est Marie qui a téléphoné. C'est demain que nous partons. Ce qui (subject), ce que (object), ce dont (de-complement) + clause + c'est + focus: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le retard. Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.

head: 형태 / Forme
초점 / Focus
예문 / Exemple
rows: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le retard.
Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.

notes.ko: 주어 강조에는 qui, 그 외에는 que를 씁니다.
notes.en: Use qui for the subject, que for the rest.

notes.ko: ce dont ... c'est 뒤에는 de + 명사/동사원형이 옵니다.
notes.en: Ce dont ... c'est is followed by de + noun/infinitive.

notes.ko: 강조된 요소가 복수여도 c'est를 씁니다(구어): C'est mes amis qui ...
notes.en: In speech, c'est is kept even before plurals.

examples.t: C'est Marie qui a téléphoné hier.
examples.ko: 나를 놀라게 한 것은 그의 침착함이었어요.
examples.en: What surprised me was his calm.

examples.ko: 우리를 구한 것은 바로 그녀의 빠른 판단이었어요.
examples.en: It was her quick judgement that saved us.

examples.t: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le retard.
examples.en: All I did was ask one question.

examples.t: Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.
examples.ko: 그가 떠난 이유는 돈이 아니라 존중 때문이었어요.
examples.en: The reason he left was not money but respect.

examples.t: Ce que je veux, c'est la vérité.
examples.ko: 내가 정말 원하는 것은 평화와 고요예요.
examples.en: What I really want is peace and quiet.

practice.q: Ce ___ j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.

trans.ko: (질문) 그 프로젝트가 성공한 결정적 요인은 무엇이었나요?
trans.en: (Question) What was the decisive factor in the project's success?

lines.t: Qu'est-ce qui vous inquiète le plus ?

options: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le retard.
Ce que m'inquiète, c'est le retard.
Ce dont m'inquiète, c'est le retard.

lines.t: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le manque de temps.
Moi, c'est le budget qui me préoccupe.
Ce dont nous avons besoin, c'est d'un délai supplémentaire.
C'est exactement ce que je pense.

trans.ko:
A: 이번 위기를 구한 사람이 누구야?
B: 바로 신입 직원이었어. 그녀의 빠른 판단이 우리를 구했어.
A: 그럼 너는 뭘 했어?
B: 나는 그냥 팀에 알린 것뿐이야.
trans.en:
A: Who saved us in this crisis?
B: It was the new employee. Her quick judgement is what saved us.
A: And what did you do?
B: All I did was let the team know.

lines.t: Le véritable problème de cette entreprise, ce n'est pas le manque de clients. Ce qui lui fait défaut, c'est une stratégie claire. C'est la direction qui doit décider, et c'est maintenant qu'il faut agir. Ce dont les salariés ont besoin, c'est de confiance.

trans.ko: 영어는 분열문으로 강조하고 싶은 부분에 청중의 주의를 집중시킵니다. It was ... that은 특정 요소를, What ... is는 핵심을 강조합니다. 이런 구문은 연설과 에세이에서 특히 효과적이지만 너무 자주 쓰면 문체가 무거워집니다.
trans.en: English uses cleft sentences to focus attention on the part you want to stress. It was ... that stresses a particular element, and What ... is stresses the core. These structures are especially effective in speeches and essays, but overuse makes the style heavy.

questions.q: Ce dont les salariés ont besoin, c'est de quoi ?

lines.t: Qu'est-ce qui compte le plus pour vous ?
Ce qui compte, c'est la liberté.
Ce dont je rêve, c'est de voyager.

trans.ko:
면접관: 회사를 떠난 이유가 무엇인가요?
지원자: 돈 때문이 아니라 성장의 기회 때문이었어요.
면접관: 그 점을 좀 더 말해 주시겠어요?
지원자: 제가 정말 원한 것은 새로운 도전이었어요.
trans.en:
Interviewer: What was the reason you left the company?
Candidate: It was not money but a chance to grow.
Interviewer: Could you say more about that?
Candidate: What I really wanted was a new challenge.

questions.q: Ce dont je rêve, c'est de ______

items.passage:
1) C'est Marie ___ a téléphoné hier.
2) C'est demain ___ nous partons.
3) Ce ___ j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.

trans.ko: 1) 나를 놀라게 한 것은 그의 침착함이었어요. 2) 우리를 구한 것은 그녀의 판단이었어요. 3) 내가 한 일은 질문 하나뿐이에요.
trans.en: 1) What surprised me was his calm. 2) It was her judgement that saved us. 3) All I did was ask one question.

questions.q: Ce ___ j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.

items.passage: Le directeur a annoncé une réforme. Ce qui (1) changer, c'est l'organisation du travail. C'est le personnel (2) devra s'adapter. Ce dont l'entreprise a (3), c'est de souplesse.

trans.ko: 논란을 낳은 것은 정책 자체가 아니라 그 발표 방식이었다. 시민들이 분노한 것은 사전 설명이 전혀 없었다는 점이다. 정부가 이제 해야 할 일은 신뢰를 회복하는 것뿐이다.
trans.en: What gave rise to controversy was not the policy itself but the way it was announced. What angered citizens was that there had been no prior explanation. All the government has to do now is restore trust.

items.passage:
ÉDITORIAL
L'essentiel
Ce qui manque à notre système éducatif, ce n'est pas l'argent, c'est la confiance. C'est aux enseignants qu'il faut donner plus de liberté. Ce dont les élèves ont besoin, c'est de sens. Voilà ce que devrait faire le prochain gouvernement.

trans.ko:
사설
신뢰의 문제
이 사태의 핵심은 정보 부족이 아니라 신뢰의 붕괴다. 시민들이 요구하는 것은 사과가 아니라 책임 있는 행동이다. 바로 그 점을 정부는 깨달아야 한다.
trans.en:
EDITORIAL
A question of trust
The crux of this affair is not a lack of information but a collapse of trust. What citizens demand is not an apology but responsible action. That is precisely what the government must realise.

questions.q: Qu'est-ce qui manque au système éducatif ?
À qui faut-il donner plus de liberté ?

items.passage: Lucie veut changer de métier. Ce qui la motive, c'est le désir d'aider les autres. Elle hésite encore, car ce dont elle a peur, c'est de l'instabilité.

trans.ko: 사설은 사태의 핵심이 신뢰의 붕괴라고 본다. 사설은 시민들이 사과를 가장 원한다고 본다. 사설은 정부가 이 점을 깨달아야 한다고 본다.
trans.en: The editorial sees a collapse of trust as the crux. The editorial thinks citizens mainly want an apology. The editorial thinks the government must realise this.

questions.q: Lucie n'a pas peur de l'instabilité.

expressions.t: C'est Marie qui a téléphoné hier.
expressions.ko: 우리를 가장 놀라게 한 것은 그의 태도였습니다.
expressions.en: What surprised us most was his attitude.

expressions.ko: 계획을 구한 것은 바로 마지막 순간의 결정이었습니다.
expressions.en: It was a last-minute decision that saved the plan.

expressions.t: Ce qui m'inquiète, c'est le retard.
expressions.en: It was only last week that he resigned.

expressions.t: Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de repos.
expressions.ko: 내가 한 일이라고는 사실을 말한 것뿐이에요.
expressions.en: All I did was tell the truth.

expressions.t: Le véritable problème, c'est le manque de temps.
expressions.ko: 우리가 실패한 이유는 준비 부족 때문입니다.
expressions.en: The reason we failed is that we were poorly prepared.

expressions.t: Ce que je veux, c'est la vérité.
expressions.ko: 정말 필요한 것은 더 많은 시간이 아니라 더 나은 계획입니다.
expressions.en: What we really need is not more time but a better plan.

expressions.t: C'est précisément ce que je voulais dire.
expressions.ko: 누구인지가 중요한 것이 아니라 무엇을 했느냐가 중요합니다.
expressions.en: It is not who you are but what you do that matters.

expressions.t: Ce qui compte, c'est de rester honnête.
expressions.ko: 바로 그 점이 우리가 다시 생각해야 할 부분입니다.
expressions.en: That is precisely what we need to rethink.

prompt.ko: 분열문과 의사분열문을 사용해 어떤 사건에서 가장 중요했던 것을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences about what mattered most in an event, using cleft and pseudo-cleft sentences.

task.model: Ce qui m'importe, c'est la qualité du travail. Ce que je cherche, c'est un poste stable. Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est de temps. C'est la direction qui décidera, et c'est lundi que nous saurons la réponse.

model_trans.ko: 그날 가장 인상 깊었던 것은 팀원들의 침착함이었어요. 상황을 바꾼 것은 한 동료의 짧은 제안이었어요. 내가 한 일이라고는 그 제안을 지지한 것뿐이에요. 우리가 성공한 이유는 서로를 믿었기 때문이에요.
model_trans.en: What impressed me most that day was the team's calm. It was a colleague's short suggestion that changed the situation. All I did was back that suggestion. The reason we succeeded is that we trusted one another.
